run_finalize_qda: run the finalize_qda script to gather ELI5 selected QDA slices into train, valid, and test JSON files
run_finalize_qda_custom_subreddit: run finalize_qda with a custom subreddit list and number of selected passages via CLI arguments
review_setup_args: review the setup_args function that configures CLI arguments for num_selected, num_context, and subreddit_list
review_main: review the main function that globs selected slice JSON files, indexes by ID, and splits into train valid test
refactor_main: refactor the main function to support additional data splits or output formats beyond train valid and test
